name: comp-482

frames.best_why: Top row is open with its full note text running across the table, which the folded frames lack.

tagline: Rows fold open to reveal a written note with an info icon.
summary: A dark account table where rows carrying a note show a chevron in the first column. Pressing it drops a full-width sub-row with an info icon and the note text; a checkbox column selects rows separately.
appearance: A black table led by a narrow chevron column and a checkbox column, then bold names, emails, flag emojis with cities, rounded status pills and right-aligned balances. Open rows add a lighter strip containing a small info glyph and a paragraph.
behaviour: Clicking a row's downward chevron unfolds a sub-row of note text and flips the chevron upward; clicking again folds it away. Rows without a note have no chevron, and the checkboxes tick independently of expansion.
demo_content: Five people with flags, status pills and balances; one note about a quarterly performance review.
search_phrases: table rows that open to show a note
expand a row for more details
data table with chevron expand buttons
click row arrow to reveal extra info
use_when: Each record carries a short note that should stay hidden until someone asks to read it.
avoid_when: Notes are long single paragraphs, so an open row pushes everything below it down a long way.
customise: Rows load from a remote JSON while columns and the note sub-row are written in the file; new fields or a different note layout mean editing the source.
weight_why: A table library over five remote rows adds one sub-row on demand; no animation loop.

a11y.note: The expander is a labelled button reporting aria-expanded, and checkboxes are labelled; note text has no heading of its own.

issues: The first column is blank for rows without a note, so the chevrons look uneven.
The caption credits the table library instead of describing the example.
Open notes appear instantly with no height animation, so the table jumps.
polish_why: Clean sub-row with an info icon and roomy spacing; a library caption and uneven expander column.
title: Expandable Rows Table
